items.prompt: Two A trades each match two A metadata rows under an equality inner join. How many joined A rows result?

options.text: One row because identical symbols merge automatically
options.why: An equality join is not a grouping operation.

options.text: Two rows because metadata duplicates are ignored
options.why: Ordinary joins retain each matching pair.

options.text: Four rows from the matching pairs
options.why: Each of two trades matches each of two metadata rows.

options.text: Zero rows because every duplicate automatically raises
options.why: A duplicate raises only if an applicable constraint rejects it.

items.explanation: Join cardinality follows matching pairs: two times two equals four. Key constraints and validation are separate from joining.
